question_text: Find if the two cubes are alike. Write 'Yes' or 'No'.

reference_figures.label: Cube 1
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><path d='M30 30 L70 30 L85 15 L45 15 Z M30 30 L30 70 L70 70 L70 30 M70 70 L85 55 L85 15' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><text x='45' y='55' font-size='20'>A</text><text x='52' y='26' font-size='15'>B</text><text x='74' y='45' font-size='15'>C</text></svg>

reference_figures.label: Cube 2
reference_figures.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><path d='M30 30 L70 30 L85 15 L45 15 Z M30 30 L30 70 L70 70 L70 30 M70 70 L85 55 L85 15' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='2'/><text x='45' y='55' font-size='20'>A</text><text x='52' y='26' font-size='15'>C</text><text x='74' y='45' font-size='15'>B</text></svg>

explanation: In Cube 1, the letters read A -> B -> C in a clockwise sequence around the shared vertex. In Cube 2, the sequence is A -> C -> B. Because the relative positions of B and C are swapped while A remains in the same place, Cube 2 is a mirrored reflection of Cube 1, not an identical rotation.
